description.zh: 侧边栏常驻显示当前计费档期与倒计时（高峰标准价 / 空闲半价），以北京时间为权威轴换算本地时间，周末与节假日全天谷价；并提供 dsh_peak_hours 工具供 Agent 安排长任务。
description.en: Persistent sidebar indicator for the current DeepSeek pricing tier with countdown (peak standard price / off-peak half price), Beijing-time authority converted to local time, weekend and holiday off-peak pricing, plus a dsh_peak_hours tool for scheduling long tasks.
